niper.source_authority: Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
niper.summary: NIPER S.A.S. Nagar (Mohali) was set up under the NIPER Act, 1998; under the NIPER (Amendment) Act, 2007 the Central Government set up new NIPERs at Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Guwahati, Raebareli and Hajipur (page text in Hindi). They award PhD and postgraduate degrees.

spa.source_authority: Parliament of India — School of Planning and Architecture Act, 2014
spa.summary: SPA New Delhi, SPA Bhopal and SPA Vijayawada are Institutes of National Importance under the SPA Act, 2014; all three are ranked in NIRF 2025 Architecture and Planning.
